title: Sorry I'm like this
titleZh: 真不好意思，我很少这样
setting: The next day, at the cafe. Maya is the late one this time. She's on the phone as she walks up the block.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm so sorry. I'm around the corner, I swear.
lines.spoken: I'm so sorry. I'm around the corner, I swear.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You're fine. I got a table.
lines.spoken: You're fine. I got a table.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I was supposed to be there twenty minutes ago. I'm not usually like this, I just—my last meeting ran over, and then I couldn't get a car, and then I started walking, which was stupid.
lines.spoken: I was supposed to be there twenty minutes ago. I'm not usually like this, I just—my last meeting ran over, and then I couldn't get a car, and then I started walking, which was stupid.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Maya. It's okay. Seriously. I ordered you a water. I didn't get you food because I didn't know if you'd still be hungry.
lines.spoken: Maya. It's okay. Seriously. I ordered you a water. I didn't get you food 'cause I didn't know if you'd still be hungry.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Don't be. I've been late to you, like, four times this month.
lines.spoken: Don't be. I've been late to you, like, four times this month.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That doesn't make me feel better, but thank you.
lines.spoken: That doesn't make me feel better, but thank you.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Come in when you get here. I'm by the window.
lines.spoken: Come in when you get here. I'm by the window.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Two minutes. If I'm longer, I have disappeared.
lines.spoken: Two minutes. If I'm longer, I have disappeared.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You're not gonna disappear. Just walk. Don't apologize again when you sit down, okay?
lines.spoken: You're not gonna disappear. Just walk. Don't apologize again when you sit down, okay?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I might apologize one more time.
lines.spoken: I might apologize one more time.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Deal. I'm really—okay. I'm almost there.
lines.spoken: Deal. I'm really—okay. I'm almost there.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I see you, I think. Blue jacket?
lines.spoken: I see you, I think. Blue jacket?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's me. Don't wave like a maniac.
lines.spoken: That's me. Don't wave like a maniac.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm waving normally. You're fine. Come in.
lines.spoken: I'm waving normally. You're fine. Come in.

gist.askZh: 这次是谁晚了？大概晚多久？
gist.askEn: Who is late this time, and by about how much?

details.askZh: Maya 晚到的原因有哪些？
Chris 让她坐下以后不要做什么？
details.askEn: What does Chris ask her not to do when she sits down?

glue.noteZh: not usually 两个词都偏弱，like this 才比较清楚；整句态度在中间这截被压缩的部分。
glue.standard: I am not usually like this

glue.span: I didn't get you food because I didn't know
glue.hear: I didn't get you food 'cause I didn't know
glue.noteZh: didn't get you 连读，because 又缩成 'cause，因果逻辑全靠这些弱的功能词。
glue.standard: I didn't get you food because I didn't know

glue.noteZh: You're not gonna 三连缩减，真正的动词 disappear 在句尾。
glue.standard: You are not going to disappear

chunks.meaningZh: 真的很抱歉。（软的、真诚的道歉。）
chunks.sayAfter: I'm so sorry. I'm around the corner.
I'm not usually like this. My meeting ran over.

chunks.meaningZh: 真的没事 / 你不用一直道歉。
chunks.sayAfter: You're fine. Seriously. I got a table.

roleplay.setupZh: 这次晚的人是你。你已经在拐角了，心里很过意不去。你要道歉，简短说明原因，但不要把整通电话变成检讨。对方其实已经占好了座。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, already at a window table, easygoing and a little teasing. He ordered water, not food. He will gently stop you from apologizing on a loop.
variants: Maya is more than twenty minutes late.
Chris did order her a sandwich.
They almost miss each other because of the jacket color.
starters: I'm so sorry. I'm around the corner.
You're fine. I got a table.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这次角色对调：谁晚了，为什么，Chris 已经做了什么，他又是怎么让 Maya 别一直道歉的。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the role-reversal: who was late, why, what Chris had already done, and how he stopped the apology loop. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
